items.quote: One of them was examined by FEI Quanta-200 SEM/EDX to have the primary crystallization phase identified.
Then, all the annealed samples were examined by FEI Quanta-200 SEM/EDX and D/Max2500DC XRD to have the equilibrium constituent phases determined.

items.atmosphere: air atmosphere at 298 K and 101 kPa
items.quote: Using the Cu Kα radiation, the XRD tests were performed in air atmosphere at 298 K and 101 kPa.
Fifteen annealed samples, namely 1-4#, 6#, 8-9#, 11#, 13-14# and 16-20#, were also tested by the differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) on the NETZSCH STA 449C equipment.
Twenty samples, 4 g for 1-8# and 4.5 g for 9-20#, were arc-melted in the water-cooled copper crucible under the protection of argon of 0.06 MPa.
